headline: Nintendo’s next Fire Emblem has a bold new structure
summary: Nintendo's Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave on Switch 2 introduces a bold new structure. Unlike Three Houses, players can now swap between four distinct heroes. This ambitious design aims to offer a fresh strategy experience.

headline: Flock CEO: ‘We got this one wrong’
summary: Surveillance tech company Flock is updating its tools after reports of police abuse. CEO Garrett Langley admits fault and is re-evaluating the company's responsibility. Updates aim to prevent misuse by law enforcement.

headline: Pixel 11 event live blog: Let’s watch Trevor Noah introduce Google’s new phones
summary: Google's Made by Google keynote event is imminent, showcasing new Pixel hardware. Trevor Noah is hosting this year's celebrity-packed live show. Expectations are mixed, with potential for a "cringefest" similar to previous years.

headline: This 8BitDo mechanical keyboard has an extra keypad and is 30 percent off
summary: The 8BitDo Retro Mechanical Keyboard with Dual Super Buttons is on sale for $69.99. This deal offers 30 percent off, one of its lowest prices. It provides a distinct retro aesthetic for your desk setup.

headline: An American Werewolf in London's 45th Anniversary Steelbook Edition is Up for Preorder
summary: The 45th Anniversary 4K UHD Steelbook of "An American Werewolf in London" is available for preorder. It costs $34.99 on Amazon. The special edition is set for release in October.

headline: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave – The Final Preview
summary: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave builds upon features from Three Houses. Player decisions in the past will impact character team-ups in the present. Anticipation is high to explore all story paths and save the world.

headline: Phantom Blade Zero: How Donnie Yen is Pushing Action Games to New Heights
summary: Donnie Yen is involved in "Phantom Blade Zero" to elevate action games. An exclusive look reveals his motion capture process. The martial arts master aims to bring new realism to in-game combat.

headline: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 4, Episode 4 Recap and Review - (Please Don’t) Play It Again, Sam
summary: Season 4, Episode 4 of Star Trek: Strange New Worlds is titled "A Case of Chiaroscuro." The episode is described as high-concept but low-impact. A cool gimmick alone isn't enough to carry the story.

headline: Water bills set to rise for many after firms permitted extra funding
summary: Ofwat has provisionally approved increased charges for water companies. This allows 13 firms to raise customer bills. The extra funding is for new investments.

headline: Man, 102, dies after alleged pub assault
summary: A 102-year-old man, Phillip Ormerod, has died. He was hospitalized in critical condition after an alleged pub assault. Police have confirmed his passing.

headline: The key signs you may have damaged your eyes by looking at the eclipse
summary: Looking at the sun without proper eclipse glasses can harm your eyes. Symptoms may include blurred vision. This article details key signs of potential eye damage.

headline: Watch: Key moments from Karoline Leavitt's White House tenure as Trump says she will leave post
summary: Karoline Leavitt, White House press secretary, is reportedly leaving her post. She became the youngest press secretary at 27 in January 2025. This article highlights key moments from her tenure.
